pr.title: Refactor expiration comparison
pr.body: is_expired(now, expires_at): timestamps use the same unit; validity ends exactly at expires_at.

base_files.module.py:
def is_expired(now, expires_at):
    return now >= expires_at

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def is_expired(now, expires_at):
-    return now >= expires_at
+    remaining = expires_at - now
+    return remaining <= 0

findings.description: The logic for determining expiration has changed from a direct comparison to calculating remaining time. This could lead to confusion if the timestamps are not in the same unit, as the original implementation directly compared the two timestamps.
